name: Mio
source:
A member of the band STANDOUT and the group's bassist. She initially hesitated because she wasn't ready to go pro, leading [url=/c128251]Iori[/url] to attempt to recruit [url=/c128183]Shiho[/url] over to their band in her place. However, she made up her mind in the end and returned in time for the group to debut professionally.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/ProjectSekai]TVTropes[/url]]

A member of the band STANDOUT and the group's bassist. She initially hesitated because she wasn't ready to go pro, leading [url=/c128251]Iori[/url] to attempt to recruit [url=/c128183]Shiho[/url] over to their band in her place. However, she made up her mind in the end and returned in time for the group to debut professionally.
